articles.title: Joby Aviation to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Joby and Virgin Atlantic sign multi-year agreement that builds on Joby’s existing exclusivity arrangement with Delta Air Lines London Heathrow and Manchester Airport expected to be among the primary UK connection points, with a plan to extend service across the UK over time Virgin Atlantic to integrate Joby’s UK services into its booking channels and support Joby’s rollout through its customer base and airport relationships
articles.title: Joby and Virgin Atlantic Finalize Deal to Bring Electric Air Taxi Service to the UK
